subject: Localization certification & UK Addendum signer matrix
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@medipoint.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Localization certification & UK Addendum signer matrix

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We ran through the high-level routing options for MediPoint and I wanted to capture two asks so we can converge before legal executes the UK Addendum / DTIA sequence.

1) Signer matrix: please confirm whether MediPoint requires board-level signature (CEO/CFO) for any deviation from the standard UK IDTA (e.g., residency carve-outs or escrow-based access). We’ve seen customers require CISO + Legal countersign for DTIA exceptions; want to align to avoid surprises.

2) Evidence scope: you mentioned HSM attestation and SOC2. Can you confirm the exact artifact types and minimal time window (e.g., most recent 12 months SOC2 + KMS/HSM attestation within 18 months)? Also need the latest subprocessors list you’ll accept as evidence (a CSV or table is fine).

I’ve attached a draft localization-certification matrix (localization-cert-matrix.xlsx) showing proposed signers per exception tier and the draft UK Addendum we intend to route after your confirmation.

Proposed internal owners:
- Legal (Kimberly) — review UK Addendum redlines
- Security (Jonas) — validate HSM/KMS attestation language + onshore fallback
- Privacy (me) — coordinate procurement cadence and DocuSign routing

Next steps: if you can reply by end of week with signer expectations and the subprocessors CSV, we’ll prepare a DocuSign packet and a short checklist for your procurement team.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachment: localization-cert-matrix.xlsx

From: Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@medipoint.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T12:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Localization certification & UK Addendum signer matrix

On 22 Apr 2027, Naomi Feldman wrote:
> Hi Sara —
> 
> Thanks again for the time yesterday...

Hi Naomi — thanks for the summary and the matrix. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Signer matrix: VP Legal (myself or delegate) + VP Procurement will be the typical signers for the standard UK Addendum. Board-level sign-off is only triggered for residency carve-outs that affect >20% of PHI processing or require an escrow access exception.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II (past 12 months) + HSM attestation (vendor letter confirming Keystone/HSM configuration and key separation) within 24 months. We also need a simple subprocessors report (name, role, hosting region) — a CSV is perfect.

I’m attaching our procurement intake form (medipoint-procurement-form.pdf) so you can map the DocuSign fields back to our internal PO flow. If you can populate the signer column in your matrix with VP Legal / VP Procurement as primary and Legal+CISO as reviewers for exceptions, that should be sufficient.

Sara Ellis
Senior Counsel, Data Privacy
MediPoint Health
sara.ellis@medipoint.com

Attachment: medipoint-procurement-form.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Localization certification & UK Addendum signer matrix

Naomi / Jonas —

Thanks, Sara — that procurement form clarifies a lot. I’ve pulled a quick internal proposal and attached a draft of the UK Addendum with callouts (uk-addendum-draft.docx). Key points from legal’s perspective:

- Standard flow: DocuSign to VP Legal (MediPoint) + VP Procurement as signers. Redwood signs via General Counsel.
- Exceptions: any residency carve-out or escrow/key-escrow access requires dual sign-off (GC + CISO) at MediPoint; internal Redwood sign-off for exceptions will be GC + Head of Security.
- Evidence mapping: we’ll accept SOC2 Type II within 12 months; HSM attestation within 24 months; where customers require KMS custody proof, we’ll provide key custody diagrams and HSM vendor attestation.

Action items (proposed):
- Naomi: map MediPoint procurement fields to DocuSign template (due 2027-04-26)
- Jonas: review HSM/KMS attestation language and confirm whether the 24-month window is acceptable, or if we need the 18-month variant (due 2027-04-25)
- Kimberly: prepare a redline of the attached UK Addendum for MediPoint review (due 2027-04-27)

I’ve added callouts in the draft where we should be careful with fallback routing (e.g., onshore cache vs. geo-routing). We should also pre-author a limited set of subprocessors that will be appended to the final DPA to avoid repeated re-negotiation.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: uk-addendum-draft.docx

I’ll loop in Platform Security (cc’d offline) to prepare a short attestation template and a one-page evidence pack we can send to MediPoint.
